_name: probe-2026-07-29-retest — only what the two fixes changed
_why: The full probe (probe-2026-07-29.json) cost $0.94 and 9 of its 13 cases are unaffected by anything shipped since. This re-runs ONLY the four that the two fixes should move, so a diff against probe-v1 is attributable.

_fixes_under_test.2ef28d8 graph literal masking: repro.cypher_uid_dot failed in probe-v1 with "properties ['SEQ'] do not exist" — the guard read an inlined 'D.SEQ' literal as <var>.SEQ. Should now return the six D.SEQ-220823SHA records.
_fixes_under_test.NEXTSEEK_CC_MAX_BUDGET_USD 0.50 -> 3.00: All three CC turns below died on error_max_budget_usd at 168s / 120s / 77s and produced empty replies, so reingest has never actually been evaluated.

_deliberately_excluded.probe.nhp_seq_engine_q1 / q2: Confirmed 408 twice. No fix shipped for the endpoint split yet, so re-running only re-confirms it.
_deliberately_excluded.probe.harmonize_genotypes: Passed all three turns with real output (188 update rows). Expensive CC, nothing changed.
_deliberately_excluded.probe.xmode_cc_then_ns: Failed, but the fix is still being investigated. Re-run once there is one.

_note_consistency: cons.nhp_sequencing_engine will run anyway: nessie.py sets run_consistency = opts['consistency'] or tier == 'full', and there is no way to switch it off. Two cheap NS turns, ~$0.02, and it re-confirms the 408.
